scheme_name: Grant of Stipend to the Differently Abled Trainees of the Vocational Training Institutes
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native/resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years

Applicant must have undertaken a full‑time vocational training course in a recognized centre (ITI, vocational training centre, workshop, or any centre run by Central/State Government, local body, or a voluntary organization)
benefits_summary: ₹1,000 per month stipend is provided to eligible trainees.
